settings.title: Split Settings
general.launchAtLoginHint: Split starts by itself when you log in to this computer.
general.showTrayIconHint: When off, open Split again to get back to these settings.
general.hideTrayConfirm: Hide Split from the notification area?
general.hideTrayConfirmHint: Shortcuts keep working. To open settings again, open Split once more.
general.windowGapHint: Leaves room between windows. Screen edges stay flush.
backend.windows: Connected to the Windows window manager.
backend.x11: X11 session. Split moves windows directly.
backend.gnome.missing: On GNOME with Wayland, Split needs its GNOME extension to move windows. See Help for how to install it.
backend.kde.ready: The KWin script is on. Change shortcuts in System Settings › Shortcuts › KWin.
backend.kde.missing: On KDE Plasma with Wayland, Split needs its KWin script to move windows. See Help for how to install it.
backend.unsupported: Split can't move windows on this desktop ({{desktop}}) yet. X11 sessions, GNOME and KDE Plasma are supported.
effects.moveFeedbackHint: Shows briefly after a window moves.
effects.showShortcutHint: The shortcut and action name appear on screen.
effects.tryHint: Changes play around this window right away.
effects.waylandHint: In a Wayland session apps can't place their own windows, so the highlight does not show.
section.SectionThirdsHint: Press again to go to the next third.
section.SectionArrangeHint: Places up to 9 visible windows on the current screen at once: 1 full, 2 side by side, 3 one big and two stacked, 4 a grid. Undo puts them all back.
shortcuts.hint: Click a shortcut to change it, or × to clear it.
shortcuts.restoreConfirmHint: Shortcuts you changed will go back to how Split came.
shortcuts.inUseHint: Another Split action uses {{shortcut}}. Choose a different shortcut.
shortcuts.taken: Another program or the system already uses this, so it could not be turned on.
shortcuts.kdeManaged: On KDE Plasma, change shortcuts in System Settings › Shortcuts › KWin. This list shows the defaults.
general.refused.windows: {{app}} refused to let Split move its window. If it runs as administrator, Split has to run as administrator too.
general.refused.linux: Split could not move the window of {{app}}. Quit {{app}} and open it again.
